Obtain signed Account namespace without authority locks before encoding, then respective existing lock_submit/status/cancel guard establishes current retained Account/family and mutation CSRF checks. Never accept caller Account as authority.

Prepare/status/cancel SQL and row decode remain inside retained guarded transaction. Validate exact cardinality, codec1, nonnil IDs, retained input account/command equality, exact allowed terminal field shape. Finish after all owner waits and commit before any projection escapes.
Unknown/missing command returns Missing only after currentAuth and confirmed commit. Decoding/statement/finalAuth failure discards transaction; no view on failure.

Existing SQL allows exact pending-command prepare/status/cancel recovery after deployment designation revocation while current Account credentials remain valid. Do not add current eligibility preflight to recovery paths. New command still requires existing owner eligibility.

Existing SQL explicitly refuses COMMITTED until full birth owner. Pure future variant does not activate SQL support or demonstrate receipt closure. No synthetic receipt/future fixture assertion can replace owner completion.

At COMMIT distinguish explicit known server refusal from unknown outcome. Communication/protocol loss and completion-unknown SQLSTATE such as40003 must be Unconfirmed; caller recovers same immutable command. No auto retry or failure claim after unknown commit. Auth40001 remains existing unavailable rather than weakening guard mapping.
No schema/migration/custody changes, serving activation, alternate writer, dynamic dispatcher, or replacement of full topology/birth owner work.
